s1loc: Skegness runs a busy events calendar on the Lincolnshire coast. The Art Deco Embassy Theatre on Grand Parade is the East Coast's premier live entertainment room, marking a century of big touring shows, while Tower Gardens and the Foreshore Gardens turn over to outdoor stages each summer. SO Festival, the free four-day outdoor arts celebration shared with Mablethorpe, brings theatre, dance, acrobatics and music to the Tower Gardens, and Skegness Carnival Week fills the streets every August.
